description: Add SWITCH_GE_MAX / SWITCH_XGE_MAX so switch-port discovery does not probe non-existent Ten-GigabitEthernet ports

add.description: Highest 1G port number to probe during switch-port discovery (default 48)
Highest Ten-GigabitEthernet port number to probe (keep small; default 4)

notes: Set SWITCH_GE_MAX to the highest 1G port across your switches. Keep SWITCH_XGE_MAX low (typically 4) so discovery does not generate 'Wrong parameter' errors on non-existent XGE ports. Both are passed through docker-compose to the web and kea containers.
